audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why and breakdown.early both open with the boilerplate 'Q-empowered autos with the blade behind him win trades' while the Level 1 row is marked Vayne's.
audit.why: Shen's Q is 400 range and he has no W or E at Level 1; Vayne is a ranged marksman with a free Silver Bolts proc every third hit. The prose contradicts the chart it sits on.
audit.corrected: Level 1 is Vayne's on range — last-hit at Twilight Assault's tip and refuse to eat Silver Bolts stacks; the lane flips at 2-3 once Shadow Dash and Spirit's Refuge are online.

audit.why: Four spikes are present and correctly ordered: Lvl 2-3 (Shadow Dash / full pattern), Lvl 6 (Stand United), 1st item, and Vayne's own 2+ item true-damage spike. This matches the win-rate shape (54.26 for Shen, falling off late).

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions are absent. (a) Condemn (E, 20/18/16/14/12s) is a knockback — it cancels Stand United's channel, and nothing on the page says so. (b) Tumble (Q, 6/5/4/3/2s) is an auto-attack reset, so her burst tell is the wind-up, not the cast.
audit.why: Shen's R is flagged 'channel — interruptible; any CC cancels it' on a 200/180/160s cooldown. Losing it to a 12-20s E is the worst single outcome in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Never start Stand United inside Condemn's 550 range; and read her Tumble reset as the step-back cue.

audit.why: Condemn is correctly identified as the punishable cooldown; real value is 20s at rank 1 down to 12s at rank 5, which makes the pre-6 bait window very long.

edits.before: Q-empowered autos with the blade behind him win trades. Identify how Vayne contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Vayne is ranged and you have no taunt yet — she wins Level 1. Last-hit at Twilight Assault's tip and refuse free Silver Bolts stacks.

edits.before: Q-empowered autos with the blade behind him win trades. Respect Vayne's Condemn completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: She out-ranges you before Shadow Dash, so give up Level 1; respect Vayne's Condemn (20s) completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Wall-stun, 20s at rank 1. Bait it, then E — her Tumble is the tell.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Condemn cancels Stand United — never channel inside her 550 range.
